body_markdown:
Get your questions ready – Plug Power is offering multiple platforms to communicate with CEO Andy Marsh in the coming week!


****


**[Quora](https://www.ir.plugpower.com/Press-Releases/Press-Release-Details/2019/Plug-Power-CEO-Andy-Marsh-to-Host-Quora-Session-on-March-7-2019/default.aspx)** The floor opens on March 4, 2019. Starting at 2pm ET,


Andy will begin taking questions via Quora


. Anyone with a


**[Quora](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=uupZuayx5__ePm41-oLz2arE-vZy1pc8Tax2fOUkiqY36EmFulwElMJn8XKA5rRNzbCCxxNULjVkkRjBnIjE4g==)** account – retail investors, media, employees, energy enthusiasts – can submit questions. Answers to these questions will go live at 2pm ET on March 7th!


**[Live Earnings Call](https://www.ir.plugpower.com/Press-Releases/Press-Release-Details/2019/Plug-Power-to-Announce-2018-Fourth-Quarter--and-Year-End-Results/default.aspx)** Also on March 7, Andy will be live from Latham, NY, providing Plug Power’s 2018 fourth quarter and year end results. Join the


[webcast](https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1234497&tp_key=ed59225253) to hear Andy’s review of 2018 and outlook on 2019 – as well as analyst Q&A.


These are both good opportunities to learn more about Plug Power and the hydrogen fuel cell industry. We hope you can join us!


#InfiniteDrive
